text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My body isn't very strong… That's what Manhattan Cafe said…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: My body feels… heavy today…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some days are like that. I'm about to tell her to take it easy and rest, when—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kssshhh… Kssshhh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I notice something bizarre. There's a trail where Manhattan Cafe walked, but it looks as if a heavy object was dragged through the sand.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: My weight… I've never seen these numbers before… What's happening?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her weight gain is abnormally drastic. And it doesn't end there…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer… My body feels dry and brittle today… It's as if my entire body's shriveled up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Screeech! Crack!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ngh?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: My… toenails… They're…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She pulls off her shoes in a panic. Her dry toenails have cracked, leaving behind what look like small holes.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: My weight… I feel incredibly light today…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That explains why I can't muster any energy… This dryness must have caused the cracks in my nails, too…
choice_data_list: Let's file down your nails and disinfect them.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What? …How does that… work?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Using some specialized medicine and supports, we reinforce her nails. It doesn't look like she'll have to take a break from races or training…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …You're amazing… Thanks to your thorough treatment, I feel a lot better now…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But more importantly, what's behind these drastic fluctuations in her weight? I figure it's time to try and get some answers.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: My appetite… I do get intense cravings sometimes. It feels as if my stomach turns into a bottomless pit…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I eat and eat, but I never feel full… so I just end up feasting mindlessly…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But then at other times, I can't eat a thing. Even when I try and force the food into my mouth, my hand completely freezes up…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But… it's not my will that's stopping my hand.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …I don't know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Is she struggling to maintain her diet? Or is this a case of paranormal activity? Our conversation leaves me with no idea. But for now…
choice_data_list: Send me a photo the next time something strange happens.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A photo… Okay. I'll send you pictures, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, I receive a photo from Manhattan Cafe. But the picture itself…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Leaves me baffled. All I can make out is a strange pattern.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That keeps happening. Which is why I haven't been able to send you any pictures of the affected areas…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's… always been like this, so there's probably nothing we can do… I think my body will always be like this…
choice_data_list: Just give me a call and we'll work things out!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Give you a call? Do you mean… whenever I like?
choice_data_list: Yes, so I can patch you up!
Yes, so I can patch you up!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you… so much…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If you don't mind helping me whenever something happens, we could figure things out somehow, and maybe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, I rack my brains for a solution and eventually come up with a comprehensive treatment plan for nursing Manhattan Cafe back into shape. However…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This isn't a matter of her body being weak. The level of weakness, and the abnormality of it all… feels borderline supernatural.
